## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 sept 2026 - 27 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Jesse Churchill_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "CREDIT CARD AUTO PAY CHARGED LATE FEE. My credit card is treated as a backup payment method instead of the main one. They want me to add my bank account but I refuse. The autopay doesn't pull on time and then they charge my card as "the backup" with a late fee. I'M BEING ROBBED. THIS IS SO GHETTO."
            2. _Grace Fern_, 24 sept 2026, 1/5: "I canceled my membership over a year ago. Now you are trying to collect for late payment. Your records are as bad as your service. Take me off your list."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 10 jul 2026 - 27 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Gino Guido_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "App very glitchy, password reset glitchy. Needs significant improvement."
            2. _Ar G_, 26 sept 2026, 1/5: "scam app. Glitchy software makes people pay $35 instead of $15. Not recommended."
            3. _AJey Calloway_, 18 jul 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
